name: Courses
description: Customers buy course content and assign these courses to their employees. Employees often take courses to earn a CE or to meet the compliance requirements of their organization.

name: Personalized Learning
description: Personalized learning is a form of highly specialized training. Proficiency is demonstrated via assessments and may be part of a personalized training plan.

name: Pro-on-go
description: Quick content! These are similar to Courses but have no exams. They are designed to be shorter content that may be a refresher course or quick skills reference.

name: MDS-RAI
description: These are like courses for Canada/US  then uploaded and published in the LMS. Exam has more attribute are more exhaustive.

name: Skill Checklist
description: Skills checklists measure learner’s competencies and ability to demonstrate specific job related tasks. They can include an observer who must sign off on the checklist.

name: Assesments
description: Assessments are performed for up skill and staffing purposes.

name: Competency Evaluation
description: A scheduled event that needs a Preceptor sign off.

name: Requirement Tracker
description: RTs are created by customers and are like a course but with less attributes. The learner can update their completion date once they have uploaded their certificate. Administrators have the ability to verify a RT completion on their dashboard. Not sure if the RT has evaluations?

name: Policies
description: Policies requires attestations from assigned users.

name: Regulations
description: Regulations may trigger new actions or training plans when changed or introduced.
